Spec: # ANT UI Browser Migration Design

## Project Overview

**Goal**: Migrate ANT UI from Electron-based desktop application to browser-based web applicat...

taskQueue.name: Replace CLI Mock with Real Execution
taskQueue.description: Update src/lib/cli.ts: Replace executeCodeTask() mock with real implementation that calls executeTask() API to get taskId, subscribes to subscribeToLogs(taskId) for real-time output via SSE, and returns object with taskId and EventSource. Remove all mock child process logic and mock log generation.
taskQueue.validationRationale: Part of API integration batch, validate after all replacements

taskQueue.name: Update Store for SSE Management
taskQueue.description: Update src/lib/store.ts: Add activeTasks Map<taskId, EventSource> to track SSE connections. Add connectionStatus field ('connected' | 'disconnected' | 'error'). Implement startLogStream(taskId) method to create and manage EventSource connections. Implement stopLogStream(taskId) to close connections. Add setConnectionStatus(status) method.
taskQueue.validationRationale: Part of API integration batch, validate after all replacements

taskQueue.name: Update App Component for API Integration
taskQueue.description: Update src/App.tsx: Remove Electron-specific useRef for watchers. Replace mock implementations with API client calls (listProjects, watchSession, executeCodeTask). Handle SSE connections properly using store methods. Add connection status tracking and display. Implement proper error handling for network failures with try/catch blocks.
taskQueue.validationRationale: Part of API integration batch, validate after all replacements

taskQueue.name: Add Connection Status Indicator
taskQueue.description: Create src/components/ConnectionStatus.tsx component to display connection status with visual indicators (🟢 Connected, 🔴 Disconnected, 🟡 Connection Error). Integrate into App.tsx or Header.tsx to show real-time connection state to ant-cli server.
taskQueue.validationRationale: Part of API integration batch, validate after all replacements

taskQueue.name: Verify Complete API Integration
taskQueue.description: Comprehensive validation of all API integration changes: Verify projects list loads from server, session data fetches correctly, task execution works with real SSE streaming, logs display in real-time, connection status updates properly, error handling works for network failures. Test complete user flow from project selection to task execution.
taskQueue.validationRationale: Final validation after batch API integration - must verify TypeScript compilation, build, and runtime behavior

taskQueue.name: Final Migration Verification
taskQueue.description: Verify all migration requirements are met: No Electron dependencies remain, browser app runs without errors, projects list from ant-cli server works, session data displays correctly, code task execution works with real-time SSE logs, connection status visible, proper error handling and retry logic implemented, works in Chrome/Firefox/Safari, desktop viewport (≥1280px) supported. Test complete user flow: open browser → fetch projects → select project → view session → execute task → stream logs → task completion.
taskQueue.validationRationale: Final comprehensive validation of entire browser-based application migration

currentTask.name: Replace Session Mock with Real API
currentTask.description: Update src/lib/session.ts: Replace watchSession() stub with polling implementation (fetch session every 2 seconds, call callback on changes). Replace loadSession() with fetchSession() API call. Remove file watching logic and browser warnings.
currentTask.validationRationale: Part of API integration batch, validate after all replacements
